pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. NOTHING: one whole empty white plate with simple dark outline, red downward arrow points at completely empty white center. Flat solid fills, no food, crumbs, objects, words, numerals or people. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
